metadata.description: Red tiles form a hanging ritual textile with geometric embroidery and fringed ends. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Diagonal stepping fields surround the motif, with slalom gates along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
